stories.title: NFL preseason Week 1 takeaways: Mendoza debuts for Raiders; Allar shines for Steelers
stories.summary: The NFL preseason is underway! How did rookies and players in new places perform in their debuts?

stories.title: Pickett not budging on No. 5 amid Daniels-LSU flap
stories.summary: LSU's DJ Pickett says he has no plans to change out of the No. 5 amid pushback from Jayden Daniels, with the Commanders' QB saying the situation won't be a distraction.

stories.title: Sources: Arnold picks Seahawks amid legal issues
stories.summary: Terrion Arnold, who sources told NFL Network plans to sign a one-year deal with the Seahawks, also had visited the Texans, Saints and Giants before choosing the Seahawks.

stories.title: 'Ascending' QB Mendoza throws TD pass in debut
stories.summary: Raiders rookie QB Fernando Mendoza completed 10 of 16 passes for 97 yards and a touchdown on four drives against the Cardinals.

stories.title: Source: Ohtani likely wouldn't opt out if team sold
stories.summary: Shohei Ohtani likely would not exercise a "key man" clause that would allow him to opt out of his contract if Mark Walter sold the Dodgers, a source told ESPN.
